messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planning to rename header from x-redwood-routehint to x-redwood-route-preference to support narrowcast/broadcast semantics. This will affect SDKs that auto-add routehint.
Mira: oh — when's this landing? Breaking for users?
Alex: Targeting next week's API roll (canary Mon). We'll keep server side accepting old header for 6w but SDKs should start emitting new header. Need graceful fallback in SDKs.
Sophia: We should show a console banner for devs with an opt-in toggle and link to migration guide. Otherwise support will get flooded. :fire: 
Liam: For quotas: routehashing will change. Need mapping layer in the quota service to map old -> new until migration completes.
Eva: Telemetry question: how do we detect clients not sending new header? Can we sample requests and flag customers?
Mira: add metric 'sdk_migration_routepref_missing' and a dashboard tile under Console > Integrations. Also send weekly usage report to workspace owners.
Alex: SDK owners — propose fallback code:
```
// pseudo
if (hasHeader('x-redwood-route-preference')) use it
else if (hasHeader('x-redwood-routehint')) use it
```
Make sure telemetry emits which header used.
Sophia: UX: show per-tenant migration progress in console, allow forcing legacy translation for specified tenants.
Liam: I'll add a thin mapping layer in quota service (v1) that remaps route keys based on equivalent semantics and tags (non-destructive). We'll tag flagged tenants.
Eva: Go SDK: I'll open PR to add new header emission behind feature flag; default off for now. Python/TS — please coordinate naming and tests.
Mira: Setting migration flag in feature-flag service: ff-routepref-rollout. Canaries start at 1% -> 25% -> 100% over 2 weeks.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for API change on 2026-03-30 03:00 UTC. :calendar: 
Alex: Action items: 1) SDK PRs (Eva/Mira/Sophia) 2) Quota mapping patch (Liam) 3) Console banner + dashboard (Sophia) 4) Telemetry metric + alert (Mira) 5) Migration doc + examples (Alex)
Mira: I'll create the migration doc and a short quickstart snippet for each SDK. Who volunteers to review?
Eva: I'll review TS and Go snippets; Sophia will do Python.
Sophia: I'll also wire the banner. ETA Thu.
Alex: Great — keep thread updated. If we see >2% of production traffic without new header after week 4 we pause rollout. :eyes: 
Mira: noted. I'll open the tracking ticket and link here.
